# Load libraries
```{R}
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, windfetch, raster, sf, terra, gdistance, glmmTMB, tmap, MuMIn, tidyterra, lme4, MASS, effects, AER, ggpubr, vegan, viridis, cowplot, biscale, RColorBrewer, caret, pROC, boot)
source("code/function script.r")
```

# 1. Load data
```{R}
site_data <- st_read("data/beaches_linked.gpkg")
debris_data <- read.csv("outputs/debris_data_with_weights.csv") %>%
               dplyr::select(!X)
gravity_data <- read.csv("outputs/gravity_final.csv") %>%
                filter(!site_name %in% c("Rattray, Grumbell, Grassy Islands", "Goat Island Beach, South Molle Island")) %>%
                dplyr::select(site_name, gravity)
exposure_data <- st_read("outputs/exposure_data.gpkg")
```
# 2. Sensitivity testing on gravity and exposure
## 2.1 Examine gravity outliers
```{R}
# Combine data sets
combined_data <- left_join(debris_data, gravity_data, by = c("Site" = "site_name"))
combined_data <- left_join(combined_data, exposure_data, by = c("Site" = "Sites")) %>%
st_as_sf()
#checking for outliers
outlier <- combined_data %>% group_by(Site) %>% summarise(gravity = first(gravity), exposure = first(site_exposure)) %>% ungroup()
boxplot(outlier$gravity)$out %>% sort()
min(boxplot(outlier$gravity)$out) # < 9.9
boxplot(outlier$exposure)$out %>% sort()
min(boxplot(outlier$exposure)$out)

#examining outliers
data_goutliers <- filter(combined_data, gravity > 9.9) #These are the gravity outliers
#Gravity outliers are not removed as they are not error outliers but rather interesting data points.
```

## 2.3 Complete data cleaning, and run correlation test bewteen gravity and exposure.
```{R}
data_complete <- combined_data_test %>% dplyr::select(1:6, pw_3_exposure, geom) %>% rename(site_exposure = pw_3_exposure)
levels_order <- c("Does Not Disperse", "Limited Dispersion", "Encumbered Drift", "Very Mobile", "Unencumbered Drift")
data_complete$floatiness <- factor(data_complete$floatiness, levels = levels_order)

#Melt high and low disperal categories together
data_reduced <- data_complete %>% mutate(floatiness = case_when(floatiness %in% c("Does Not Disperse", "Limited Dispersion") ~ "Low dispersal capacity",
                                                                floatiness %in% c("Encumbered Drift", "Very Mobile", "Unencumbered Drift") ~ "High dispersal capacity"))
data_reduced <- data_reduced %>% group_by(Site, year, num_cleans, gravity, site_exposure, floatiness, geom) %>%
                summarize(Totals = sum(Totals))
levels_order <- c("Low dispersal capacity", "High dispersal capacity")
data_reduced$floatiness <- factor(data_reduced$floatiness, levels = levels_order)
#st_write(data_reduced, "outputs/clean_up_sites.gpkg")
#Correlation test results
forcortest <- data_complete %>% group_by(Site) %>%
              summarize(gravity = first(gravity), exposure = first(site_exposure)) %>%
              ungroup()
cor.test(forcortest$gravity, forcortest$exposure)
#Significant correlation, correlation -.21

# Saving parameters for scaling
parameters <- list()
 parameters[1] <- attr(data_reduced$site_exposure, "scaled:center")
 parameters[2] <- attr(data_reduced$site_exposure, "scaled:scale")
 parameters[3] <- attr(data_reduced$gravity, "scaled:center")
 parameters[4] <- attr(data_reduced$gravity, "scaled:scale")
names(parameters) <- c("site_exposure_center", "site_exposure_scale", "gravity_center", "gravity_scale")
saveRDS(parameters, "outputs/scaling_parameters.rds")
```

# 4. Create predictive models
## 4.1 Fit models
```{R}
#Tried poisson distribution, but overdispersion was present so switched to negative binomial

#Full model results (all categories)
#Generate the model
model_complete <- glmmTMB(Totals ~ gravity + site_exposure + floatiness + gravity*floatiness + site_exposure*floatiness + (1|Site) + (1|year),
                                   offset = num_cleans,
                                   data = data_complete,
                                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"))
#check for overdispersion
deviance(model_complete) / df.residual(model_complete) # > 1
car::Anova(model_complete, type = "III")
summary(model_complete)
saveRDS(model_complete, "outputs/full_model.rds")
#write.csv(as.data.frame(summary(model_complete)[[6]][[1]]), "outputs/full_model_results(exposure power 0.3).csv")

#Perform model selection
  # options(na.action = "na.fail")
  # mod_sel <- dredge(model_complete, trace = TRUE, rank = "AICc")
  # print(mod_sel)
  # write.csv(as.data.frame(mod_sel), "outputs/model_selection(no_adjustments)_results.csv")

model_melted <- glmmTMB(Totals ~ gravity + site_exposure + floatiness + gravity*floatiness + site_exposure*floatiness + (1|Site) + (1|year),
                        offset = num_cleans,
                        data = data_reduced,
                        family = nbinom2(link = "log"))
#check for overdispersion
deviance(model_melted) / df.residual(model_melted) # > 1
car::Anova(model_melted, type = "III")
summary(model_melted)
saveRDS(model_melted, "outputs/melted_model.rds")
write.csv(as.data.frame(summary(model_melted)[[6]][[1]]), "outputs/melted_model_results.csv")
  options(na.action = "na.fail")
  mod_sel <- dredge(model_melted, trace = TRUE, rank = "AICc")
  print(mod_sel)
  write.csv(as.data.frame(mod_sel), "outputs/model_selection(melted)_results.csv")
```
# 4.2 Test model robustness through k fold cross validation
```{R}
fit_model <- function(train_data) {
  glmmTMB(
    Totals ~ gravity + site_exposure + floatiness + gravity*floatiness + site_exposure*floatiness + (1|Site) + (1|year),
    offset = num_cleans,
    data = train_data,
    family = nbinom2(link = "log")
  )
}

#Perform K-fold cross validation
perform_kfold = function(k, data){
folds <- createFolds(data$Totals, k = k, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)
auc_values <- c()
  for (i in 1:k) {
    train_indices <- folds[[i]]
    test_indices <- setdiff(1:nrow(data_reduced), train_indices)
  
    train_data <- data_reduced[train_indices, ]
    test_data <- data_reduced[test_indices, ]
  
    model <- fit_model(train_data)
  
    # Predict on test data
    predicted_probs <- predict(model, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
    actual <- test_data$Totals
  
    # Calculate AUC
    roc_curve <- multiclass.roc(actual, predicted_probs)
    auc_value <- auc(roc_curve)
    auc_values <- c(auc_values, auc_value)
  }
  return(auc_values)
}
#For K = 5
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
auc_values <- perform_kfold(5, data_reduced)
mean_auc <- mean(auc_values)
print(mean_auc) #0.9974931

#For K = 10
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
auc_values <- perform_kfold(10, data_reduced)
mean_auc <- mean(auc_values)
print(mean_auc) #0.9992113
#For K = 30
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
auc_values <- perform_kfold(30, data_reduced)
mean_auc <- mean(auc_values)
print(mean_auc) #0.9992063

#Leave one out cross validation
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
n <- nrow(data_reduced)  # Number of observations
all_actual <- c()
all_predicted_probs <- c()

for (i in 1:n) {
  test_indices <- i
  train_indices <- setdiff(1:n, test_indices)
  
  train_data <- data_reduced[train_indices, ]
  test_data <- data_reduced[test_indices, ]
  
  model <- fit_model(train_data)
  
  # Predict on test data
  predicted_probs <- predict(model, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
  actual <- test_data$Totals
  
  # Accumulate actual and predicted probabilities
  all_actual <- c(all_actual, actual)
  all_predicted_probs <- c(all_predicted_probs, predicted_probs)
}
# Calculate AUC for multiclass
roc_curve <- multiclass.roc(all_actual, all_predicted_probs)
mean_auc <- auc(roc_curve)
print(mean_auc) #0.9861
```
